explanation: Ecdysozoans represent a large group containing roundworms and arthropods. Roundworms (Nematoda) are non-segmented nematodes that can be free-living or parasitic. Caenorhabditis elegans is a major model organism used in scientific research. Parasitic roundworms include Ascaris (infecting humans and animals), Trichinella (causing trichinosis, a serious infection from eating uncooked pork), filarial worms, and pinworms.
